title: Bounded repair tasks
boundary: Create repair tasks through an approved routine. No automatic push, merge, tag or release.
error: Could not update repair settings. Verify the pinned routine, owner, workspace and budget.
disabled: Automatic repair is disabled by the operator.
loginRequired: Sign in as the responsible company owner or administrator to authorize repairs.
routineHelp: Use an active routine attached to this source task, with Always enqueue, the same project, your responsible identity and a local coding Agent.
limitHelp: Costs are checked before dispatch. A project hard budget and unknown-cost blocking are also required. The window stops new dispatches, not running provider tasks.
confirm: I authorize these repair tasks to use this Agent, workspace and budget.
noCancel: Pausing does not cancel tasks already dispatched. Attempts never reset when settings change.
empty: No repair task has been reserved.
